card.name: Opening parenthesis after book titles
card.fires_on: Mostly the opening parenthesis right after a book title in a footnote citation, before the publisher and year. Also small linking words like "the" or "for" in old missionary or history prose.

modes.label: Citation parenthesis
modes.description: The "(" that follows an italic-style book title in a footnote reference, before the publisher.

modes.label: Linking words in historical prose
modes.description: Words like "the", "for", "in" or "our" in older mission and history writing, just before a name or institution.
modes.example: In 1921 the League of Nations established<< the>> Committee on the Traffic in Women and Children
